_what: Starter feedback stages for a Shopify store with Klaviyo. Who gets each form, when (Klaviyo trigger, filters, wait) and what the flow already knows. Copy into brands/<brand>/operations/, set klaviyo.public_id and form.url, and mark stages you can't trigger as blocked with why.
label: <Brand>

form.link_note: Put this exact link on the email's button, with {stage} filled in. `e` is the profile's email so the answer lands on the right Klaviyo profile. The page reads it, then wipes it from the address bar before anything else runs; the page loads no ad pixels, so the email never reaches Meta/TikTok/Snap. If Klaviyo click tracking adds `_kx` to the link, the page uses that instead and `e` can be dropped.
form.repo: <where the form page lives: the store's theme or a page repo>

email.style: Plain founder note, no images, one link — the look of the three survey emails that collected 1,807 answers (T | Delivered › 'Brand Improvement Survey', template SMpqA6; T | Cancelled/Refund › 'Email #1 - Refund', template TXTuVD). Klaviyo footer as those emails have it: {% unsubscribe %} · {{ organization.name }} {{ organization.full_address }}.
email.reward: The old emails promised a <reward> code shown after answering. The code itself is not on file (it lived on the Google Forms' confirmation screen). Put the code in feedback-questions.json › reward.code and the thank-you screen shows it; until then the emails below carry no reward line.
